# Backlog

- As of 2026-10-09, PR #415 is completed rather than a backlog blocker. It merged into `main` as `756e3be5` from exact head `60d77e15c7e0a8ccd825af89b06445628cdc8e8a`. One strict ASCII canonical-path rule is reused by archive creation, local publication, the SSH verifier, transfer authentication, and project CAS digesting. NFC/NFD names and case-only archive collisions fail closed without publishing a payload. Exact-head CI passed 4/4; the full suite passed with 5,374 passed and 1 skipped.
- As of 2026-10-09, activation of the merged memory-rewrite format remains pending PR 6 completion and per-project migration validation. The implementation includes versioned atomic memory saving, shared local/SSH receiving-side publication, single-pass archive preparation and fingerprinting, ASCII-path enforcement, schema validation, and migration support. No project uses the new format yet.
- As of 2026-10-09, PR 6 activation work is in progress on branch `feat/memory-core-pr6-activation` as PR #425 at `9d15e9097270c3d954ab67153c3a5cde879bf080`. Exact-head CI passed 4/4 and the full suite passed 5,381 tests with 1 skipped, but review found a blocker: profile/schema transactions cannot be undone, including `--resolve-kind` changes that remove entries. Review also found that production capability validation synthesizes the required capability set and that real migration, updater-race, and publication-failure coverage is missing. A repair is in progress; no merge or real-project migration completion is recorded.
- As of 2026-10-09, the nested-marker overflow-recovery repair is active in worktree `.worktrees/overflow-recovery` on branch `fix/eviction-nested-markers-overflow-recovery`; no PR, merge, or validation result is recorded yet. The repair covers valid prior compaction rows in persisted views, fresh eviction fallback for corrupt views, emergency recovery after provider overflow, and provider-limit safety calibration.
- As of 2026-10-09, literal `@` references that do not resolve to usable local attachments are under active repair in worktree `.worktrees/at-refs-text` on branch `fix/at-refs-never-block-send`; no completion, PR, or validation result is recorded yet.
- As of 2026-10-09, an older eviction risk remains a follow-up: existing transformations, including semantic `read` digests and repeated-read collapsing, can replace a candidate without checking whether it is strictly smaller under the supplied `token_counter`. A reviewer observed an adversarial counter increasing an existing digest from 2 tokens to 100,001; this was not introduced by PR #422.
- As of 2026-10-09, session `9bd2840975ef42e490c268b433ea0096` ended with an actual provider context-length failure after repeated evictions: Anthropic reported 1,000,386 tokens against a 1,000,000-token maximum. Investigation found a high-confidence compound regression on build `756e3be5`: PR #420's estimator measured 831,610 tokens where the provider measured 1,000,386, while the pre-#420 estimate was 1,046,517; PR #423 invalidated the resumed pre-#423 eviction view, making forced eviction a no-op. `/compact` did not recover the session (`compacted=false`). Generic overflow-recovery tests passed 2/2. No repair is merged, and the user has started a new session rather than resuming this one.
- As of 2026-10-09, short receipts for `inbox` results remain a user-supported follow-up. The minimum-gain rule with summary fallback remains unresolved because it was compared to the old compaction behavior.
- As of 2026-10-09, removal of the model-facing `project_update` tool remains unresolved in deslop PR 4 and is homelab-gated; it is intentionally outside the memory rewrite PR 4 scope.
- As of 2026-10-09, submission handling of literal text containing `@get` remains an open UX follow-up: the user reported that a message could not be sent because the referenced item was not a real file on the laptop, and considered that behavior weird.

Its final repair rejected unsupported Unicode project paths, reused one ASCII canonical-path rule at all publication and digest boundaries, passed six NFC/NFD regressions and focused validation, and received a final MERGE-READY review with no blockers.
- As of 2026-10-09, PR #423 merged into `main` as `f368df57`. Its persisted-view receipt repair applies the normal deterministic receipt constructors to eligible raw rows, preserves protection and provider-payload invariants, and passed exact-head CI.
- As of 2026-10-09, PR #424 merged into `main` as `c3846133`; its flaky-test repairs covered non-blocking stream publication, parallel-child result mapping, parent-abort hang bounds, and the image watchdog race.
